assertions.head_surface: DESMI centrifugal pumps with electric motor
assertions.tail_surface: less than 2.8 mm/s vibration velocity (measured in 3 directions at motor flange level on vertical pumps) during a factory test
conditions: measured in 3 directions at motor flange level
assertions.applicability: DESMI centrifugal pumps with electric motor; vertical pump installation
assertions.evidence_text:
As standard DESMI centrifugal pumps with electric motor generate less than 2.8 mm/s vibration velocity (measured
      in 3 directions at motor flange level on vertical pumps) during a factory test.

assertions.tail_surface: shorter lifetimes of e.g. bearings and/or shaft seals in pumps (and bearings in motors) than normally expected
assertions.applicability: pump and electric motor industry general agreement; DESMI centrifugal pumps
assertions.evidence_text:
The pump and electric motor industry generally agrees that vibration levels above 7 mm/s are damaging – i.e. this
      will result in shorter lifetimes of e.g. bearings and/or shaft seals in pumps (and bearings in motors) than normally
      expected.
This agrees with the recommendations in the international standard ISO 10816-3.

assertions.head_surface: external excited vibrations from main engine and/or auxiliary machinery
assertions.tail_surface: much higher vibration velocities than 7 mm/s
conditions: transferred from ship hull to the pump
assertions.evidence_text:
But in pump installations on ships external excited vibrations from main engine and/or auxiliary machinery are
      transferred from ship hull to the pump often resulting in much higher vibration velocities than 7 mm/s.
